about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Whole Baked Snapper with Lemon, Herbs and Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.summary: A whole snapper baked on a bed of lemon slices, herbs and tomatoes, served at the table with crusty bread.

items: 1 whole snapper, about 1.2kg, scaled and gutted

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slash the fish three times on each side and rub with oil and salt.
Scatter half the lemon, garlic, tomatoes and parsley in a tray, lay the fish on top and fill the cavity with the rest.
Bake for 30 minutes until the flesh flakes at the thickest part, then serve with the bread.
notes: Contains gluten (bread), soy and fish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Whole Fish Foil Parcel with Lemongrass, Ginger and Lime
recipes.summary: A whole fish steamed in a foil parcel with lemongrass, ginger, chilli and lime, served with jasmine rice.

items: 1 whole snapper, about 1kg, scaled and gutted

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Place the fish on a large sheet of foil and fill the cavity with lemongrass, ginger and chilli.
Pour over the lime and fish sauce, fold the foil into a sealed parcel and bake for 25 minutes until the flesh flakes.
Open carefully, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice and the juices.
notes: Dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Garlic Prawn and Chorizo Pan with Crusty Bread
recipes.summary: Prawns and chorizo sizzled in garlic and paprika oil, mopped up with bread and a tomato salad.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges, add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and curled, then add the tomatoes for 1 minute.
Finish with lemon and parsley and serve with torn baguette.
notes: Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.

Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day. Cook the chorizo until it reaches 75°C.

recipes.title: Mussels in Tomato, White Bean and Chilli Broth
recipes.summary: Mussels steamed open in a chunky tomato and cannellini broth with chilli and basil.
steps: Soften the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the mussels, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the shells open; discard any that stay closed.
Scatter with basil and serve with toasted bread.
notes: Contains gluten and molluscs.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Crab Linguine with Lemon, Chilli and Parsley
recipes.summary: Fresh crab meat tossed through linguine with lemon zest, chilli and olive oil.
steps: Cook the linguine in salted water until tender, reserving 1/2 cup of the water.
Warm the oil with the garlic and chilli for 2 minutes, add the crab for 2 minutes until hot through.
Toss in the pasta, lemon and parsley with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
notes: Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Salt and Pepper Squid with Lime Mayo and Slaw
recipes.summary: Crisp-fried squid rings with a light cornflour coat, lime mayonnaise and cabbage slaw.
steps: Toss the squid in cornflour, pepper and salt, shaking off the excess.
Shallow-fry in hot oil in batches for 2 minutes until golden and opaque, then drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with half the lime, toss the slaw with the rest and serve together.
notes: Contains egg, gluten and shellfish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Braised Octopus and Potato Plate with Paprika Oil
recipes.summary: Tender braised octopus on warm potatoes, finished with smoked paprika oil and lemon.
steps: Simmer the octopus with the bay leaves in water for 60 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then slice.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender and drain.
Warm the oil with the paprika for 1 minute, layer the potatoes and octopus on plates, spoon over the oil and finish with parsley and lemon.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Seared Scallops with Pea Purée and Crisp Prosciutto
recipes.summary: Golden scallops on a bright pea purée with crisp prosciutto, a quick dinner-party main.
steps: Crisp the prosciutto in a dry pan for 2 minutes until crunchy and set aside.
Simmer the peas in the stock for 4 minutes until tender, then blend with the butter and lemon until smooth.
Sear the scallops in the oil for 90 seconds each side until golden and opaque, and serve on the purée with the prosciutto.
notes: Contains dairy and molluscs.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Grilled Lobster Tails with Garlic Herb Butter and Corn
recipes.summary: Lobster tails grilled with garlic butter and served with charred corn on the cob.
steps: Melt the butter with the garlic and parsley. Split the lobster shells lengthways and brush with the butter.
Grill the lobster flesh side down for 4 minutes and flip for 4 minutes until opaque and firm; grill the corn alongside for 10 minutes, turning, until charred.
Serve with the remaining butter and lemon.
notes: Contains dairy and crustacean shellfish. Gluten free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Lemon Zest Prawn Skewers with Quinoa and Avocado
recipes.summary: Prawns rubbed with lemon zest and grilled, served with lime quinoa and avocado.
steps: Toss the prawns with the lemon zest, oil and salt and thread onto skewers.
Cook the quinoa in water for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy, then stir in the lime juice.
Grill the skewers for 3 minutes each side until pink and curled, and serve over the quinoa with avocado, tomato and coriander.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Finger Lime Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
recipes.summary: Pan-fried white fish in soft tacos with cabbage slaw, avocado and a squeeze of finger lime or lime.
steps: Toss the fish with the paprika, cumin and oil, then pan-fry for 3 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and coriander for the slaw.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the fish, slaw, avocado and yoghurt.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and fish. Finger lime pearls can replace the lime juice when in season.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: High-Protein Turkey Chilli Meal Prep with Sweet Potato
recipes.summary: Lean turkey mince and kidney beans in a smoky chilli, served over baked sweet potato in batches for the week.
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 8 minutes, add the onion, capsicum and garlic for 5 minutes, then the spices.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 25 minutes until thick; the mince must reach 75°C.
Split the baked sweet potatoes, spoon over the chilli and cool the rest in portions.
notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: High-Protein Tuna and White Bean Pasta Boxes
recipes.summary: A cold lunchbox pasta of tuna, white beans, cherry tomatoes and olives in a lemon dressing.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until tender, drain and cool under cold water.
Toss with the tuna, beans, tomatoes, olives, oil, lemon and parsley.
Pack into boxes and keep refrigerated until lunch.
notes: Contains gluten and fish.

Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

recipes.title: Lunchbox Egg and Vegetable Frittata Slices
recipes.summary: Baked frittata with zucchini, capsicum and cheddar, cut into slices for cold lunchboxes.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and oil a 20cm tin. Whisk the eggs and milk, then stir in the vegetables, cheese and spring onion.
Pour into the tin and bake for 30 minutes until set in the centre and golden.
Cool, slice into six and pack chilled.
notes: Contains egg and dairy.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

recipes.title: Cold Roast Beef and Beetroot Wraps
recipes.summary: Sliced roast beef, grated beetroot, rocket and horseradish yoghurt in wraps for a cold packed lunch.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, horseradish and mustard.
Spread over the wraps, then layer the beef, beetroot and rocket.
Roll tightly until snug, wrap and keep chilled.
notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: use beef that was cooked to at least 63°C and cooled quickly; keep wraps chilled below 5°C and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Lunchbox Spiced Yoghurt Chicken and Cucumber Pita Pockets
recipes.summary: Baked yoghurt-marinated, spiced chicken in pita with cucumber, lettuce and mint yoghurt, eaten cold.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chicken with half the yoghurt, garam masala, paprika and oil and roast on a tray for 18 minutes until cooked through at 75°C.
Cool, then mix the remaining yoghurt with the mint.
Stuff the pita with the chicken, cucumber, lettuce and mint yoghurt and pack chilled.
notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

recipes.title: Freezer-Batch Beef and Lentil Cottage Pie Pots
recipes.summary: Beef mince and lentils under sweet potato mash, portioned into freezer pots for quick dinners.
steps: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until tender and drain. Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes until soft and mash with the butter.
Brown the mince, onion and carrot in the oil for 10 minutes, add the paste, stock, Worcestershire and lentils and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Spoon into 8 pots, top with mash, cool and freeze. Bake from thawed at 190°C for 25 minutes until steaming hot and golden.
notes: Contains dairy, gluten (Worcestershire) and fish.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Freeze in portions for up to 3 months; reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Freezer-Batch Vegetable and Chickpea Curry Pots
recipes.summary: A mild coconut curry of chickpeas, cauliflower and spinach, frozen in single portions.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and cauliflower and simmer for 20 minutes until the cauliflower is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, cool and freeze in portions. Reheat until steaming hot.
notes: Vegan and gluten free. Freeze for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Freezer-Batch Chicken Enchilada Bake Portions
recipes.summary: Layered tortillas with shredded chicken, beans, salsa and cheese, baked, cut and frozen in portions.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, then shred and mix with beans, corn, cumin and 1 cup of salsa.
Layer the tortillas, filling and cheese in a tray, finishing with the remaining salsa and cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until bubbling, cool, cut into 8 and freeze. Reheat until steaming hot.
notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Freeze for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Smoky Roast Pumpkin and Lentil Bowls
recipes.summary: Roast pumpkin dusted with smoked paprika over warm lentils, with yoghurt and rocket.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the pumpkin with the paprika, oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes until tender and caramelised.
Simmer the lentils in water for 25 minutes until tender and drain, then toss with lemon.
Serve the lentils topped with pumpkin, rocket and yoghurt.
notes: Contains dairy. Gluten free. Vegetarian.
